scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's identity and account information to ensure accurate assistance.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Tailor the conversation to the customer's specific needs and account details.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Acknowledge the customer's concern and express understanding of their frustration.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Rephrase the customer's issue to ensure understanding and show that you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Maintain a polite and respectful tone throughout the conversation.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask diagnostic questions to gather more information about the customer's problem.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Assume responsibility for resolving the issue and avoid blaming other departments or the customer.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly confirm that the issue has been resolved to ensure customer satisfaction.
